full_text:
ADDENDUM <Rule No. 940, October 25, 2022>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Period of Validity)
These Rules shall remain effective for five years from the date of their promulgation.

Article 3 (Applicability concerning Imposition of Anti-Dumping Duties)
These Rules shall apply beginning with goods for which import declarations are filed after these Rules enter into force.
